anchor_constraints.policy: Presence of every supplied anchor label including __MISSING__; proportions audited, no proportional count bounds

limitations: 54 is the user-chosen repair size: original 40 plus one per missing category, not a coverage-derived optimum.
All original 40 landmarks are locked. Building-type, region and anchor proportions are audited and penalized, not enforced as quotas.
Every supplied anchor label, including the separate missing-label category, must appear. Presence does not prove visible elements or usable masks.
The exhaustive minimum is only among additions to this fixed original 40 under the stated score, not among all possible 54-landmark subsets.
Random comparisons are descriptive on training features used for selection; they are not independent validation or statistical significance tests.
Coverage describes the 317 training landmarks only; the 79 evaluation landmarks are excluded.
VGGT features describe whole photographs, including backgrounds; mean/std can miss multimodal appearance.
Anchor labels are supplied metadata, not measured anchor visibility or complete architectural-element inventories.
Blur, exposure, camera/viewpoint coverage, depth/mask completeness and anchor visibility are not measured here.
Coverage and balance are optimized on these descriptors. Random percentiles are descriptive, not p-values or independent validation.
No reconstruction or intervention outcomes are used or tested. Outcome stability needs a separate experiment.
Selected manifests keep every original image path, including duplicate content; raw photos are not copied by this selector.

common_target_comparison.interpretation: Both evaluated on the SAME 263 landmarks outside the repaired set; additions cannot increase nearest distance on this fixed target

random_repair_reference.conditioning: frozen original40 plus one uniform choice per missing anchor category; repeated memberships expected

matched_random_reference.conditioning: same building-type by anchor counts as selected subset, and all training regions present
